Customer-facing products live under the Products section. What lives here is the substrate.* **Strale's product is decision-ready outcomes for agents.** Counterparty Assurance is the flagship; Web3 Assurance is present; future \*-Assurance products plug in here (per DEC-20260502-A and DEC-20260503-A). Underneath sits a horizontal substrate with six core capabilities (per DEC-20260420-E): discovery, routing, orchestration, entity resolution, decision-readiness, and audit trail. Plus the `source_health` substrate (per DEC-20260503-B, replacing the deleted SQS scoring engine), the Capabilities catalog, and `apps/api/coverage-matrix/` in the repo (canonical per DEC-20260517-A; was Notion Provider-Coverage DB before the 2026-05-17 migration) that maps capabilities to underlying providers. Each subpage below is canonical for its domain. When a subpage and another document disagree, the subpage wins and the other document is updated. # Subpages **Substrate pages, rewritten 2026-05-03 under DEC-20260503-A/B:** Capabilities & solutions SQS — Quality scoring Audit Trail — Decision logging Discovery — Findability for agents **New stubs** (canonical content drafted 2026-04-20): ⚠️ ARCHIVED 2026-05-17 — Provider-Coverage DB (canonical → apps/api/coverage-matrix/) Routing engine Entity resolution Decision-readiness Orchestration **Databases:** Feature Registry *(The Provider-Coverage matrix moved to **`apps/api/coverage-matrix/`** in the repo on 2026-05-17 per DEC-20260517-A; the archived Notion DB sits under its parent page above for the 30-day read-only window.)* # Relationship to DEC-20260420-E's six substrate capabilities
DEC-E substrate capability Canonical page
Discovery Discovery — Findability for agents
Routing Routing engine (per-product, per DEC-20260503-B — see page)
Orchestration Orchestration (new, canonical)
Entity resolution Entity resolution (new, canonical — highest engineering priority per DEC-G)
Decision-readiness Decision-readiness (new, canonical)
Audit trail Audit Trail — Decision logging
Plus three supporting pages: SQS — Quality scoring (substrate redesign per DEC-20260503-B; the page now describes `source_health` and the deletion of the scoring engine), Capabilities catalog (the primitive set, with `marketplace_eligible` carve-out per DEC-20260503-A), `apps/api/coverage-matrix/` (capability × country × evidence_type mapping; canonical in repo per DEC-20260517-A). --- *Section created 2026-04-20 as part of the Notion restructuring under DEC-20260420-E/F/G/H.
